name: Neon Hearts
source:
You are a troubled college student at the end of his rope after being dumped by your girlfriend and expelled from university. With your attempts to make something of yourself foiled, you consider ending it all. But just as you are about to commit to the act, you are stopped by a beautiful woman who offers you a job at her cabaret!
Seeing this as a second chance, you take the job and are brought to the club where you meet a myriad of gorgeous girls. It’s not the life you’d planned for yourself, but with some hard work and a little luck, you might just be able to turn things around… and find love in the process!


[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250128235727/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.chabakura]Google Play[/url]]
